title: Kumanovo maturants' online-class boycott over state-matura subjects
reason: Evidence describes students boycotting online classes, not a public in-person assembly. Class attendance and enrollment do not establish a simultaneous crowd.
notes: Sakam Da Kazam reports Kumanovo students skipping online classes and names schools; A1on/Alsat/Denesen search results describe school/city boycott claims. Do not treat those figures as gathering attendance. Possible street actions mentioned by Nova Makedonija remain separate pending-evidence lead E006.
